title: Integration profiles
description: The synced file integrations.json: names and flags of connections to clusters, subscriptions and domains, never a credential and never a path of one computer. Limits: at most 64 profiles, the whole file is at most 256 KiB, at most 32 variables and at most 8 secret names per profile, at most 1024 bytes for the value of a variable, at most 64 characters for the name of a profile and for the name of a variable. A kube profile pins a context and a namespace, a talos profile a context and a node, an azure profile a subscription and a gam profile a section; only azure and gam profiles can be isolated. What a schema cannot say is checked by the loader, and a file that fails any rule is refused as a whole: profile ids are unique; the environment names that the runner denies, that the app sets itself or that start another program are refused; a plain value that looks like a path is refused; a secret name is listed once and is not also a plain variable; invisible and space-like characters other than control characters are refused; every cap above counts bytes in the loader and characters in this schema; a section is not a word that GAM reads as a keyword; a node is an address or a DNS name; the same key twice in an object is refused.

profiles.description: The profiles, in the order the person sees them.

id.description: The id: lower-case letters, digits, underscore and dash, not starting with a dash.

tool.description: The tool the profile is for.

name.description: What the person calls the profile.

context.description: The context it pins (kube and talos): no leading dash, no leading or trailing space.

namespace.description: The namespace it pins (kube): one DNS label.

subscription.description: The subscription it pins (azure), by its GUID.

node.description: The node it pins (talos): an address or a DNS name.

production.description: Whether the pinned context is production.

isolated.description: Whether the tool runs with a configuration directory of its own (azure and gam).

env.description: Plain environment variables: the name and the value, no control character.

secret_env.description: The names, never the values, of the variables whose values are in the keychain.

allOf.description: A kube profile pins a context and a namespace; the other selection fields stay empty, and it cannot be isolated.
A talos profile pins a context and a node; the other selection fields stay empty, and it cannot be isolated.
A azure profile pins a subscription; the other selection fields stay empty.
A gam profile pins a section; the other selection fields stay empty.

envName.description: The name of an environment variable.

noControl.description: A text without a control character.

unused.description: A selection field that the tool does not take.
